gateCatalog.paired-recovery-sites-version-aligned: Both recovery sites run the same supported legacy appliance level before transition.
gateCatalog.enhanced-replication-confirmed: Existing replications use Enhanced Replication before unified-appliance convergence.
gateCatalog.replication-health-clean: No replication is paused, broken, or carrying an unresolved synchronization error.
gateCatalog.legacy-recovery-at-9.0.2.2: The legacy Live Site Recovery appliance is at the supported convergence prerequisite.
gateCatalog.unified-appliance-fresh-deployed: VCF Protection and Recovery 9.1 is a fresh deployment; this is not an in-place appliance upgrade.
gateCatalog.recovery-plan-test-passed: A non-disruptive recovery-plan test and cleanup completed before migration.
gateCatalog.installer-converge-workflow-selected: An estate with NSX uses VCF Installer convert/import convergence rather than independent component upgrades.
gateCatalog.nsx-imported-before-9x-upgrade: Standalone NSX 4.x is imported into VCF before any NSX 9.x lifecycle operation.
gateCatalog.nsx-backup-complete: A restorable NSX configuration backup is verified.
gateCatalog.recovery-stack-9.1-compatible: Legacy recovery services have transitioned to a release compatible with vCenter 9.1.
gateCatalog.nsx-under-fleet-management: The NSX instance is visible to VCF lifecycle management.
gateCatalog.vcenter-file-backup-complete: A file-based vCenter backup and restore precheck are complete.
gateCatalog.vcenter-target-active: vCenter is already running the target release before ESXi hosts advance.
gateCatalog.hardware-compatibility-validated: Server, I/O, firmware, drivers, and storage devices match the target compatibility guides.
gateCatalog.evacuation-capacity-confirmed: The cluster can evacuate one host while satisfying compute and storage policy requirements.
gateCatalog.all-esxi-target-active: Every contributing vSAN host is at the target ESXi release.
gateCatalog.vsan-health-green: vSAN health checks report no unresolved finding.
gateCatalog.no-resync-active: No vSAN object resynchronization is active.
gateCatalog.no-in-place-osa-to-esa: The brownfield OSA cluster remains OSA; an ESA design requires a separately built cluster and data migration.
